guide_notes_p1: Zaɓi kowane rubutu don sanya shi Bold ko Italic daga toolbar mai yawo — kuna iya haɗa duka biyun a kalma ɗaya.
guide_notes_p2: Haɗa hotuna daga gallery ko kyamararku kai tsaye a cikin bayanin lura; hotuna ana ajiye su a cikin na'ura kuma suna kasancewa amintattu.
guide_notes_p3: Ajiye bayanin lura don kiyaye shi a saman jerinku — danna valik-⋮ ko ka riƙe katin na tsawon lokaci don ajiye shi ko cire shi.
guide_checklist_p1: Danna akwatin alamar don nuna an kammala abu; danna alamar tsara kwas don sauyawa tsakanin: Marasa kammala tukunna, Kammalallu tukunna, ko tsarin A→Z.
guide_checklist_p2: Gididdije layin hagu don goge shi nan take. Siffar taƙaitacciya tana nuna kowane abu a layi ɗaya.
guide_checklist_p3: Katin bayanin lura yana nuna jimillar abubuwa da nawa aka kammala — kallon sauri na ci gaba ba tare da buɗe bayanin ba.
guide_itinerary_p1: Kowane shigarwar mazauni yana ɗauke da sunan wuri, lokacin isowa, lokacin tashi, da filin lura don lambobin ajiya ko kwatance.
guide_itinerary_p2: Danna alamar kwanan wata ko lokaci a kowane shigarwa don buɗe cuftirgal da sake tsara lokaci — shigarwa suna kasancewa a tsarin lokaci ta atomatik.
guide_itinerary_p3: Katin bayanin lura yana nuna jimillar mazaunai yadda zaku iya ganin cikakken tsarin tafiyarku a kallo ɗaya.
guide_meal_plan_p1: Kowane layin rana yana da guraben karasawa, abincin rana, abincin dare, da abun ci na tsaka-tsaki — bar kowane gurbi reras ko cire shi idan ba a buƙata. Ƙara layuka kamar yadda ake buƙata.
guide_meal_plan_p2: Danna gurbin abinci don rubuta sunan abinci ko ƙara gajerun bayanai kamar tunatarwar shiryawa; canje-canje suna ajiyewa ta atomatik.
guide_meal_plan_p3: Katin bayanin lura yana nuna kwanaki nawa aka tsara, yana ba da taƙaitaccen bayani na take ba tare da buɗe cikakken bayanin ba.
guide_recipe_p1: Saita lokacin shiryawa, lokacin girki, da yawan mutane a sama — yawan mutane yana bayyana a katin bayanin lura don dubawa na sauri.
guide_recipe_p2: Ƙara abubuwan girki da suna da yawa; ja handle ɗin kowane layi don sake tsara tsarin ba tare da gogewa ko sake ƙarawa ba.
guide_recipe_p3: Matakai suna samun lamba ta atomatik — saka mataki a kowane gurbi na jerin kuma lambobin suna sabunta kansu.
guide_drawing_p1: Zaɓi alkalami, highlighter, ko goge-rubutu daga toolbar na ƙasa; daidaita kalar zane da kaurinsa kafin fara zane.
guide_drawing_p2: Soke ko sake dawo da kowane zane daban-daban da maballan ↩ / ↪ — riƙe kowane maballi don tafiya da sauri a tarihin zane.
guide_drawing_p3: Danna fito da hoto a cikin toolbar don adana zanenku a cikin gallery na na'ura a matsayin cikakken hoto na PNG.
guide_security_p1: Duk bayanan lura na yau da kullun da zane-zane suna da kariya ta AES-256 ta amfani da maɓalli da aka samo daga asalin password ɗinku na sirri — ba za su kasance masu karantuwa ba in babu shi.
guide_security_p2: Bayan buɗewa na farko cikin nasara, kunna biometrics a ƙarƙashin Settings don samun damar shiga cikin sauri ta alamun yatsa ko Face ID.
guide_security_p3: Alamar kore 🔒 a katin bayanin lura tana nufin an kiyaye shi da asalin password na jooni. Alamar orange tana nufin an kiyaye shi da wani password na daban — shigar da asalin password don karanta shi.
guide_sync_p1: Shiga da Google a ƙarƙashin Settings → Account; danna Upload ko Restore don turawa ko janyowa — yi amfani da account guda ɗaya a kowace na'ura.
guide_sync_p2: Bayan sake sanyawa, shiga kuma danna Restore daga Drive — aikace-aikacen yana dawo da gishirin tsaronku don duk bayanan su buɗe daidai.
guide_sync_p3: Lokacin da aka yi gyara ga bayani guda a na'urori guda biyu, ana nuna alamar matsala don ku zaɓi Keep Local, Keep Remote, ko Keep Both.
guide_controls_p1: Danna katin bayanin lura don buɗe shi; riƙe kowane kati na tsawon lokaci don shiga yanayin zaɓar abubuwa da yawa — sannan danna ƙarin katuna don ƙarawa a zaɓin.
guide_controls_p2: Gididdije katin hagu don goge shi. A cikin bayanin lura, danna ⋮ don ajiye shi, canza kala, canza rukuni, ƙara hoto, ko goge bayanin.
guide_controls_p3: Danna alamar ido 👁 a katin bayani don duba shi ba tare da buɗe edita ba — mai amfani don karantawa cikin sauri ba tare da barin jerin ba.
guide_organisation_p1: Danna alamar bincike 🔍 a bar na sama don bincika kowane nau'in bayani — sakamakon yana haɗa lakabi, rubutu, abubuwan jerin dubawa, mazaunai, abinci, da abubuwan girki duka lokaci ɗaya.
guide_organisation_p2: Danna alamar sort nau'i don sauyawa tsakanin: Sababbi tukunna, Tsoffi tukunna, ko siffar rukuni — a siffar rukuni kowane rukuni (Na kowa, Aiki, Na sirri, Tunanin aiki) ana iya collapsed.
guide_organisation_p3: Sanya rukuni ga kowane bayani a cikin edita ta hanyar layin kwakwalwa na ƙasa da lakabi; sanya kala da ⋮ → Canza Kala don bambance bayanai a kallo ɗaya.
faq_lock_icon_q: Me yasa bayani na yake nuna alamar orange da saƙon password na daban?
faq_lock_icon_a: Alamar orange tana nufin bayanin an kiyaye shi da asalin password daban da wanda yake aiki jooni. Wannan yana faruwa yawanci bayan sake shigar da aikace-aikacen da ƙirƙirar sabon password. Shigar da asalin password da aka yi amfani da shi lokacin ƙirƙirar bayanin don samun damar shiga.
faq_forgot_password_q: Me zai faru idan na manta asalin password na sirri?
faq_forgot_password_a: Bayanan sirri suna da kariya ta end-to-end da AES-256 kuma babu wanda zai iya dawo da password — har da edita. Idan kuna da amintaccen backup a Google Drive da aka yi lokacin kuna da password, maido da shi kuma shigar da takamaiman password. In babu asalin password, bayanan sirri ba za su buɗe ba. An tsara wannan don kare sirrin ku.
faq_sync_devices_q: Yaya zan daidaita bayanai a tsakanin na'urori?
faq_sync_devices_a: Je zuvac Settings → Account kuma shiga da account na Google guda 1 a kowace na'ura. Danna Sync Now don loda bayanai ko saukarwa. Bayan sake sanyawa a sabuwar na'ura, shiga tukunna sannan danna Restore daga Drive — aikace-aikacen zai kawo gishirin tsaronku yadda password ɗinku zai iya buɗe komai daidai.
faq_notes_missing_q: Me yasa bayani na sirri ba su bayyana ba bayan sake sanyawa?
faq_notes_missing_a: Bayanan gida ana ajiye su ne a cikin na'urarku kuma ana goge su lokacin da kuka cire aikace-aikacen. Idan an kunna tsarin Drive sync, sake shiga a ƙarƙashin Settings → Account kuma danna Restore daga Drive. Idan kun fitar da backup na JSON ta hanyar Settings → Storage → Download Notes JSON, danna Upload Notes JSON don dawo da shi.
faq_no_account_q: Zan iya amfani da NoteLiha in babu account?
faq_no_account_a: Ƙwarai — duk nau'ikan bayani guda shida (Note, Checklist, Itinerary, Meal Plan, Recipe, Drawing) suna aiki offline in babu account toraade. Bayanan ana adana su kuma suna samun kariya a cikin na'ura. Ana buƙatar account ne kawai idan kuna son Google Drive sync ko cross-device backup.
faq_export_backup_q: Yaya zan fitar da ko backup bayanan sirri na?
faq_export_backup_a: Wannan tsarin yana nan jooni tan ga Google Synced Users kaɗai. Je zuwa Settings → Storage kuma danna Download Notes JSON don adana fayil ɗin backup amintacce a kan na'urarku. Don maido da shi, danna Upload Notes JSON kuma zaɓi wannan fayil ɗin. Bayanan suna kasancewa amintattu a cikin fayil ɗin, saboda haka adana shi a kowane gurbi yana da aminci.
faq_canvas_preview_q: Me yasa zane yake yiyata daban a katin bayani na jerin rubutu?
faq_canvas_preview_a: Katin bayani yana nuna ƙaramin hoto na zanenku don sauƙaƙe aikin na'ura. Zanen cikakken hoto ana kiyaye shi a kowane lokaci — danna bayanin edita don buɗe shi da girma na asali. Hoton katin yana sabuntawa duk lokacin da kuka adana zane.
faq_biometrics_q: Yaya alamun yatsa ko Face ID yake aiki?
faq_biometrics_a: Bayan shigar da password dinku na sirri daidai a karon farko, kuna iya sanya alamun tsaro a ƙarƙashin Settings. A duk lokacin buɗewa na gaba alamun yatsa ko Face ID zai bayyana da kansa. Idan alamun tsaro ba su yi aiki ba ko aka soke su, aikace-aikacen yana komawa zuwa allon password na sirri.
faq_reorder_checklist_q: Zan iya sake tsara ko lissafa abubuwan jerin dubawa?
faq_reorder_checklist_a: Ƙwarai. A cikin bayanin jerin dubawa, danna alamar sort a cikin toolbar don sauyawa a tsakanin manual order, A→Z, Z→A, Marasa kammala tukunna, ko Kammalallu tukunna. Kuna iya ja kowane abu da handle ɗinsa don sanya shi a daidai gurbin da kuke so — tsarin sort ɗin da kuka zaɓa ana adana shi ga kowane bayani.
faq_delete_note_q: Yaya zan goge bayani gaba ɗaya har abada?
faq_delete_note_a: Gididdije katin hagu don nuna zaɓin goge rubutu, ko riƙe kati don shiga yanayin za Zaɓar abubuwa da yawa sannan a goge katuna da yawa lokaci ɗaya. Bayanan da aka goge suna tafiya zuwa Recycle Bin — buɗe Settings → Recycle Bin don dawo da su ko goge su gaba ɗaya.
faq_recover_note_q: Na goge bayani ta hanyar kuskure — zan iya dawo da shi?
faq_recover_note_a: Ƙwarai. Bayanan da aka goge ba sa fita nan take — suna tafiya tukunna zuwa Recycle Bin. Buɗe Settings → Recycle Bin, nemo bayaninku, kuma danna Restore don dawo da shi. Bayanan suna fita har abada ne kawai idan kuka danna Empty Recycle Bin, saboda haka kuna da lokaci mai yawa don gyara kuskure.
faq_share_note_q: Yaya zan tura bayanin lura na sirri ga wani?
faq_share_note_a: Riƙe bayanin na tsawon lokaci sannan danna alamar Share don tura shi a matsayin rubutu na yau da kullun. Ana tsara rubutun ta siffar nau'i — abubuwan jerin dubawa suna ɗauke da alamar su, abubuwan girki suna lissafa kayan girki da laabi, tsarin tafiya yana nuna kowane mazauni da lokaci. Don tura bayanai da yawa lokaci ɗaya, riƙe kati don shiga yanayin zaɓar abubuwa da yawa, zaɓi adadin da kuke buƙata, sannan danna alamar share a bar na sama.
faq_change_colour_q: Yaya zan canza kalar bayanin lura?
faq_change_colour_a: Buɗe bayanin kuma danna ⋮ → Canza Kala don zaɓar kalar da kuke so (kamar Sunset, Lavender, Rose, da Forest). Kalar da kuka zaɓa tana bayyana a matsayin layi a katin bayani na jerin rubutu, yadda zai kasance mai sauƙi don gane bayanai daban-daban duka kallo ɗaya. Kalar tana nan ga kowane bayani daban kuma kuna iya canza ta a kowane lokaci.
